title: environment.chain_state
description: Constraint schema for environment.chain_state. Member of the environment.* primitive family established by environment.market_state (agent-intent/verifiable-intent PR #9) and environment.wallet_state (agent-intent/verifiable-intent PR #22). v0.1-draft. Family-wide sections (§4.6 freshness, §4.7 algorithm agility, §4.8 field scope, §5.5 family composition, §6.8 JWKS caching, §6.9 cross-chain temporal, Appendix C register discipline) live upstream in the verifiable-intent PRs and will be lifted into environment-charter alongside market_state and wallet_state in a coordinated v0.2 round.

type.description: Constraint type discriminator. MUST be the literal string 'environment.chain_state'.

attestation_url.description: HTTPS endpoint at which the verifier fetches the signed attestation. Family-wide-trust-root-agnostic (see §4.8). Per-type wire-protocol variance (HTTP verb, request body) is carried by attestation_request_body and §4.1, not by this field.

trusted_jwks.description: HTTPS URL of the JWKS document the verifier uses to discover the issuer's signing key. Per-type-trust-root-mechanism-bound (see §4.8). Trust binds to this URL; URL migration is a new-mandate event (see §6.3).

expected_kid.description: Expected key identifier in the published JWKS. The verifier MUST select the key whose kid matches this field; selection by any other criterion is non-conforming. Per-type-trust-root-mechanism-bound (see §4.8).

expected_issuer.description: Expected issuer identity. For Ed25519 attestations matching the environment.market_state signing-stack precedent, this is the issuer hostname carried in the attestation envelope. Per-type-trust-root-mechanism-bound (see §4.8).

chain_id.description: CAIP-2 chain identifier for the subject chain. REQUIRED, no fallback. This is the per-member distinguishing field for §5.5 family composition. Examples: 'eip155:1', 'eip155:8453', 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp', 'bip122:000000000019d6689c085ae165831e93', 'cosmos:cosmoshub-4'. Per-type-evaluation-mechanism-bound (see §4.8).

expected_status.description: Status value the attestation MUST carry for the constraint to satisfy. Verifiers MUST reject when attestation status differs from this value. The four-element enum mirrors environment.market_state's OPEN/CLOSED/HALTED/UNKNOWN cardinality and fail-closed posture; UNKNOWN is included so a mandate may explicitly require an UNKNOWN attestation (rare; useful for testing) but consumers MUST NOT treat an UNKNOWN attestation as satisfying expected_status: LIVE. Per-type-evaluation-mechanism-bound (see §4.8).

max_attestation_age.description: Maximum acceptable wall-clock age, in seconds, between attestation issuance and constraint evaluation. Family-wide-trust-root-agnostic (see §4.6). REQUIRED with no default; verifiers MUST reject mandates where this field is absent or malformed. Family-wide semantics: this is the consumer-policy bound on the TOCTOU window between the issuer's freshness telemetry and the agent's L3 verification.

stale_cache_fallback_permitted.description: Whether verifiers MAY use an expired JWKS cache as a last-resort fallback when fresh JWKS fetch fails. Per-type-trust-root-mechanism-bound (see §4.8). OPTIONAL; verifiers MUST apply default false when absent. If present, MUST be boolean; non-boolean values MUST be rejected as malformed. Mandates with strict-freshness requirements MUST NOT set this to true.

max_cross_chain_skew_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable wall-clock divergence, in seconds, between the chain-tip timestamps of the multiple environment.chain_state attestations in a single mandate. Per-type-evaluation-mechanism-bound (see §4.8). OPTIONAL; absent means no cross-chain skew bound is imposed. Verifiers MUST evaluate cross-chain skew only when the mandate's environment.chain_state constraints anchor to more than one chain_id. See §6.9.

min_finality_depth.description: Minimum acceptable confirmation depth at attestation time. Per-type-evaluation-mechanism-bound (see §4.8). OPTIONAL; absent means no finality-depth check beyond per-attestation freshness. Semantics for 'finality' are chain-family-specific and declared by the issuer out of band; see §6.9. Verifiers measure finality depth via independent chain read at verification time.
